author: ivanlitteri
content:
What I mean is:
- Daisugi adds features on top of some base branch
- This base branch currently isn't `bogota-devnet-2` (the most Hegota up-to-date EL branch out there) but a Nethermind-specific branch which implements just EIP-8141, EIP-7906, EIP-8250, and some form of EIP-8288. 
- This isn't a common ground for all ELs, and now that we want more clients to easily join, we need this common ground. It'd be better to base Daisugi features (mostly 8288 work) on top of a common ground for EL clients, i.e., `bogota-devnet-2`.
- Otherwise, we'll need to maintain a separate branch with just the features I mentioned above.
- Clients will still need to maintain a branch for Daisugi, but we can reuse the branch that we are all agreeing on today as a base and upgrade it as Bogota devnets upgrade.
